name: Yume o Mou Ichido
source:
The protagonist Sasaki Hitomi is a 28-year-old office lady who works for a foreign advertising agency. In the beginning, when she graduated high school and had just joined the company, Hitomi's position as a "business assistant" was in name only and in reality she was made to do odd menial chores around the office. However, through a stroke of luck her abilities and hard work were recognized and now she is a very busy career woman. A few men had proposed to her in the past but Hitomi had a reason why she absolutely couldn't bring herself to get married.

"Shun..."

On TV was the face of her first love, whom she broke up with.
Just another day in Hitomi's busy life, still unable to let go of her faint feelings for him.

"One day, you will definitely come back for me."

Perhaps she couldn't let go because they fell apart at the same time as graduating high school. Perhaps it was because she glorified memories of her first love to be grander than they actually were. As opposed to her unchanging feelings, time continued to pass on by... and various dramatic situations began to unfold between Hitomi and the men in her life.

Mirai presents this "mature" love story, during the season in which snowfall changes to falling cherry blossom petals.

[Translation of [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=258285&gc=gc]Getchu's story summary[/url].]
translation:
主角佐佐木瞳是一名28歲的上班族，在一家外商廣告公司工作。剛從高中畢業進入公司時，她名義上的職位是「業務助理」，實際上卻只能在辦公室裡處理各種瑣碎雜務。不過，機緣巧合之下，她的能力與努力獲得肯定，如今已經成為一名工作繁忙的職業婦女。過去曾有幾名男子向她求婚，但瞳有一個無論如何都無法讓自己走入婚姻的理由。

「瞬……」

電視螢幕上，出現了與她分手的初戀情人的面容。
這只是瞳忙碌生活中普通的一天，而她仍然無法放下對他的淡淡情愫。

「總有一天，我一定會回來找你。」

也許是因為兩人恰好在高中畢業時分開，她才始終無法釋懷；也許是因為她把初戀的回憶美化得遠比實際更加動人。她的感情始終未變，時間卻不斷流逝……瞳與生命中那些男人之間，也開始上演種種充滿戲劇性的故事。

Mirai為你獻上一段「成熟」的愛情故事，發生在落雪化作飄舞櫻花的季節。

[翻譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=258285&gc=gc]Getchu的故事簡介[/url]。]
